meta.description: Catalog, map and inquiries are free. Premium listing at a fixed monthly price. Booking commission is 0 % today.

pricing.title: Browsing is free. Standing out is Premium.
pricing.lead: Catalog, map and inquiries are open to everyone, prices are never hidden from guests. Premium lifts one listing to the top of the list and the map.

commission.heading: Booking commission
commission.line: Booking commission is 0 % today. Once bookings exceed 100 per month it becomes 2 to 3 %, announced in advance.
commission.note: The tariff is frozen when an order is sent: a commission change never touches orders already sent.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: In the dashboard you pick the number of months and see the total and the payment details. Payment is manual for now: after the transfer the platform confirms it and the listing becomes Premium immediately. Payme and Click come later.
faq.a2: Only the position and the badge: the listing comes first in its category within the chosen sort, stands out on the map, and analytics open up. The number of views or inquiries is not guaranteed.
faq.q3: What if I have several listings?
faq.a3: Premium is bought per listing. With more than five listings the Contract plan is easier: contact us and we agree a price by volume.
faq.a4: When more than 100 orders a month go through the platform. Once the threshold is reached we announce it at least 30 days ahead; the rate will be 2 to 3 %.
faq.q5: Do terminal and siding owners pay?
faq.a5: No. The terminal page, tariffs, spots and accepting bookings are free. Claiming a private siding from the registry is free as well.
faq.a6: No. Tariffs and listing prices are open without login. An account is needed only to see the phone number and send an inquiry.
